name: @scopeblind/passport
stderr:
@scopeblind/passport CLI

Create, wrap, publish, or verify portable agent packs.

Usage:
  passport create --name "Luna" --runtime openclaw [--policy shadow]
  passport wrap --runtime openclaw --config ./openclaw.json [--policy email-safe]
  passport publish --dir ./scopeblind-agent-luna [--registry https://...]
  passport verify-agent --kid sb:agent:abc123 [--registry https://...]

Commands:
  create         Create a new passported agent pack
  wrap           Wrap an existing runtime or MCP config with passport + policy
  publish        Publish agent manifest to the evidence registry
  verify-agent   Verify another agent's trust profile

Supported runtimes:
  openclaw, claude-desktop, cursor, generic-mcp

Policy packs:
  shadow, web-browsing-safe, email-safe, strict

Examples:
  npx @scopeblind/passport create --name "Luna" --runtime openclaw --policy shadow
  npx @scopeblind/passport wrap --runtime openclaw --config ./openclaw.json --policy email-safe
  npx @scopeblind/passport publish --dir ./scopeblind-agent-luna --api-key YOUR_KEY
  npx @scopeblind/passport verify-agent --kid sb:agent:abc123
